newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria set for early EMU membership - Klima.
newsitem.headline: Austria set for early EMU membership - Klima.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima said on Thursday Austria was set to be among the first members of Europe's planned economic and monetary union (EMU) in 1999.
"I am convinced that Austria will meet all criteria to be in the first group of countries to join," he told journalists.
Social Democrat Klima, who became chancellor last month after the resignation of Franz Vranitzky, added that EMU should not be postponed beyond its planned starting date in 1999.
"There is no alternative to the start of EMU in 1999," he said.
The Austrian government has forecast the country's overall budget deficit at no more than 3.0 percent this year, down from about 4.0 percent last year.

Negotiations over the 1998/99 budget are planned to start next month, and Klima has said he wants the package to be sealed by the end of the summer. ((-- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274 ))
